eba_CO:x4.en: Termination not for cause: The contractual arrangement has expired/ended and has not been renewed by any of the parties
eba_CO:x4.fr: Résiliation sans motif: L’accord contractuel a expiré/a pris fin et n’a été renouvelé par aucune des parties

eba_CO:x5.en: Termination for cause: The contractual arrangement has been terminated, the ICT third-party service provider being in a breach of applicable law, regulations or contractual provisions

eba_CO:x7.en: Termination for cause: The contractual arrangement has been terminated due to weaknesses of the ICT third-party service provider regarding the management and security of sensitive data or information of any of the counterparties
